title: Oven Roasted Polish Walnuts Salad
description: A nutty, crisp salad featuring oven-roasted Polish walnuts and red onions wrapped in foil, served over fresh greens with a zesty lemon dressing.
instructions: Toss the walnuts with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread them on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes until fragrant.
Coat the sliced red onion with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper, place it in a foil packet, and bake for 10 minutes until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, halved cherry tomatoes, and chopped parsley.
Add the roasted walnuts and cooked red onions to the bowl, drizzle with lemon juice and the remaining olive oil, and toss gently to coat.
Season the salad with additional salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
